method_notes.bm25: BM25EvidenceRetriever, top_k=5, no metadata rerank. Same retriever class as the published BM25 verdict baseline.
method_notes.bm25_metadata_rerank: BM25 scores on up to 30 positive-score candidates, then MetadataBoostReranker, truncated to top_k=5. Boosts are added to raw BM25 scores.
method_notes.dense_lsa: Cosine over corpus TF-IDF singular vectors, dimension requested 32, 15 subspace iterations, no metadata rerank.
method_notes.dense_lsa_metadata_rerank: Same TF-IDF singular-vector cosine scores on up to 30 candidates, then MetadataBoostReranker, truncated to top_k. Boosts are added to cosine scores.
method_notes.dense_proxy: Existing DeterministicTokenEmbeddingProvider dimension 64: one hashed bucket per token, no IDF. Offline dense proxy, not a neural embedding, and not the published 66.7% verdict accuracy.

metrics_omitted_note: This ablation does not report verdict accuracy, numeric correctness, contradiction detection, unsupported-claim rate, answer faithfulness, memo usefulness, latency, or cost. Predictions are marked not_scored. The published full-engine 83.3% and BM25 66.7% figures are verdict accuracies from the existing benchmark, not outputs of this run.

setup.corpus_construction: Same constructed benchmark corpus as the published verdict benchmark: gold evidence specifications plus known distractors. Claim text is copied into both gold and distractor document text.
setup.embedding: Sublinear TF-IDF fit on benchmark document text only, then a 15-step subspace iteration toward the leading right singular vectors. Query and document vectors are the L2-normalized projections, rounded to 8 decimal places. This is not a LAPACK SVD and not a neural embedding.
setup.implementation: Pure Python float arithmetic. No BLAS and no neural model.
setup.recall_at_1_note: evidence_recall_at_1 is the same ranked list cut to the first hit. It is a second cutoff, not a separate retrieval system. Recall@5 can sit near the ceiling because top_k is 5 and the task set has 200 gold evidence rows across 60 tasks.
setup.reranker: MetadataBoostReranker adds company +0.15, fiscal period +0.15, allowed source type +0.12, and metric +0.12 to the base retrieval score inside the positive-score candidate pool, then truncates to top_k.
